slides.title: GENOTYPE VS PHENOTYPE: DOMINANT AND RECESSIVE
THE KEY TERMS
lines: Dominant (B) shows if even one copy is present
slides.note: Recessive traits show only with two copies (bb).

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: Brown eyes (B) are dominant to blue (b). What is the phenotype of Bb?

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
steps: A recessive trait needs two copies

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: Dominant means more common or stronger
points: Dominant only means it masks the recessive allele.
Heterozygous (Bb) and homozygous dominant (BB) look identical.
